acme_purchasing: Hey, invoice INV-2026-0813 is blocked by billing — says 'VAT ID invalid' and reverse-charge wasn't applied. We uploaded a resale certificate (PDF). PO# PO-7890 is required on invoice too. Can someone unblock? :pray:
elena_support: Thanks for the ping — looking into it. Can you confirm the VAT ID you provided and attach the resale cert again? Also is the billing entity the same legal name as on the cert? :eyes:
acme_purchasing: VAT ID we put on the order is `GB999123456` (the PDF shows "GB 999 1234 56" with spaces). Legal name on cert is "Lumina Holdings Ltd" — matches billing details. Attached the PDF again.
lukas_billing: Running a quick VIES lookup now. Quick note: VIES treats country code for the UK as "GB" historically, but EU UI sometimes expects different formats after Brexit — sometimes lookups fail.
vies-bot: VIES lookup result for GB999123456 -> ERROR: Member state code 'GB' returned status: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE (timeout).
elena_support: Thanks — VIES timed out. In these cases we can accept manual evidence if file contains: company legal name, VAT ID, signature/date, and statement of resale. Lukas, is that acceptable from billing side?
lukas_billing: Manual evidence ok if meets policy. Two things we need to verify before applying reverse charge: 1) VAT ID plausibly valid (format + matching name). 2) Certificate explicitly states resale / business-to-business use and is signed. From the attached PDF I can see the VAT ID but the signature page is low-res. Can we get a clearer scan?
acme_purchasing: We can send a higher-res scan. One question — the cert includes a secondary VAT ID for a sister entity (FR123456789). Will that confuse the automation? We only want GB ID used.
sabrina_finance: That can confuse automated matching. For now we'll do a manual override but need to record which VAT ID to apply. Please confirm in your reply which legal entity + VAT ID should be used on the invoice (exact string).
acme_purchasing: Confirm: use Lumina Holdings Ltd / GB999123456 (no spaces). Also prefer PO# on invoice.
jon_sales: FYI — customer on Dedicated plan, prefer we resolve quickly. If billing needs a signed declaration we can loop legal. :+1:
elena_support: I've flagged billing to accept manual override once we get the higher-res file with a visible signature and a short confirmation email from the purchaser confirming Lumina Holdings Ltd / GB999123456. Lukas, can you also note the override in the invoice metadata so we have an audit trail?
lukas_billing: Will do. After manual approval I'll re-issue the invoice with reverse-charge and PO# PO-7890 annotated. ETA ~ end of day if they send the scan now. :white_check_mark:
acme_purchasing: Sending high-res scan and confirmation email now. Thanks all.
elena_support: Great — marking thread pinned for billing audit. Closing once invoice reissued. :memo:
